title: CI consumes Verifiable Intent evidence from the wrong path
evidence: Run 34712013396 and the dependency-update run 34712122792 both fail after the build because build/credentials/plugins/verifiable-intent/reports/vi-kotlin-immediate.json does not exist. The module writes under its own build directory. All later coverage, observability, SBOM, and commit-binding gates are skipped.

title: Provider qualification is still an emulator qualification
evidence: The new PKCS#11 lifecycle and restart tests pass with SoftHSM. There is no retained run against an identified Accountly production-equivalent KMS/HSM resource, including loss, restore, rotation and audit-log evidence.

title: Several published surfaces remain deliberately partial
evidence: Verifiable Intent rejects multi-pair L2, PAdES is a throwing placeholder, ServiceNow issuance and verification remain TODOs, and DIDComm encrypted packing requires a host crypto adapter. These limits must either be completed or excluded from a 1.0 support claim.

title: The reviewed SaaS candidate is not a reproducible commit
evidence: The checkout contains 98 modified and 58 untracked paths, including authorization, rate limiting, migrations, custody, billing delivery and CI. HEAD and origin/main remain e2d1c474, so the strongest current implementation is not reviewable or deployable as one immutable candidate.

title: Deployment qualification can report zero exercised requests
evidence: python -m unittest discover -s scripts fails test_load_budget_uses_all_configured_request_types: run_load raises 'load exercise produced no requests'. A short but valid duration can terminate before the first request, so the harness is not dependable evidence.

title: The committed SDK source pin predates the custody-qualified SDK
evidence: Committed main pins TrustWeave 6c62fa0e; the working tree changes it to dbec32c0, while the current SDK main is 8190a9ab. Accountly therefore has no committed CI evidence against the SDK candidate assessed in this review.

title: Hosted CI and production qualification evidence are unavailable
evidence: GitHub run 34712022688 started zero steps because account payments failed or the spending limit was reached. The manual staging qualification workflow has no successful hosted run proving deployed load, restart/restore, alert acknowledgement, cross-tenant rejection and KMS rotation.

title: The full backend suite did not produce a final result
evidence: The current working tree compiled and many emitted tests passed, including billing durability and security controls, but :server:test stopped emitting progress for several minutes and was terminated during this review. It therefore supplies partial evidence only.

title: No promoted, attested cross-repository release pair exists
evidence: There is no green workflow that binds a tested SaaS image, SBOM, vulnerability result, SDK source digest, deployed qualification result and rollback/restore evidence to one promoted production version.
